name: @shipworthy/example-commonjs-typescript-5
description: A React Native style app: CommonJS, TypeScript 5.0 pinned by an npm override, NodeNext resolution, TanStack Query 5.59, and npm's legacy peer dependency handling.

scripts.verify: openapi generate tanstack-query openapi.json -o src/generated --name pets && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bundler.json && node runtime.cjs
